http/client_protocols#

Which HTTP version a client speaks on a connection: what ALPN selected on TLS, or the configured one on cleartext.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Which HTTP version a client speaks on a connection: what ALPN selected on TLS, or the configured one on cleartext. HttpTransport uses it.

Public API#

object HttpClientProtocols#

object HttpClientProtocols

Agreement is checked without route/transport effects. Actual ALPN remains definitive; the advertised list alone never selects the wire protocol.

HttpClientProtocols.HttpClientProtocols#

HttpClientProtocols(policy is ClientPolicy, tls is TlsClientPolicy)

The protocols policy and tls allow.

HttpClientProtocols.selected#

selected(protocol is string) is HttpVersion

The version for the ALPN protocol ("" when none); UnsupportedHttpVersion for one not enabled.

HttpClientProtocols.clear#

clear() is HttpVersion

The version for cleartext: HTTP/1.1 when enabled, else HTTP/2 prior knowledge.
